tools.name: search_events
tools.description: Find events in Latvia (concerts, theatre, exhibitions, festivals, cinema, kids' events, nightlife…) on a day or in a date range, optionally in one city, one category, matching words, free only, or from a time of day. With no dates it searches today in Riga time. The answer says today's date in Riga;

tools.name: get_event
tools.description: Full details of one event by its id from search_events: description, organizer, every upcoming date with its venue and ticket link, price range and map location.

tools.name: events_happening_now
tools.description: Events that are on at this moment in Latvia (started and not yet ended, by Riga time), optionally in one city or category.

tools.name: list_cities
tools.description: Latvian cities and towns that have upcoming events on EventApp, biggest first, with how many.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: The event categories in use (English and Latvian names), most upcoming events first, each with its EventApp page.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Keyword search over upcoming events in Latvia, for clients that need a generic search tool. Returns ids for fetch. Prefer search_events, which also filters by date, city and category.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: The full record of one event by the id search or search_events returned, as a document.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
